notes.title: New character added: Kia de Hex!
notes.notes:
Some believe that she melts down all the gold she collects to create a powerful, magical amulet. Others say that she uses it to pay off the lease on her hoverboard... 

Whatever the case, we are excited to introduce the [b]all-new[/b], slightly magical and very fast character [b]Kia de Hex[/b]! Available to claim in the game right now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33972224/2c08dfc1328b2eaa8f4bc957003ee1156755f5b4.png[/img]

notes.title: Weekly Contest: Win $50 Steam Gift Cards!
notes.notes:
Are you slightly better than your friends in Slightly Heroes 1v1 multiplayer matches? Prove it by joining this competition! [b]Hold a Top 5 Weekly Leaderboard spot[/b] by April 21, 1pm PT/10pm CEST & you’ll receive a [b]$50 Steam Digital Gift Card![/b] 

Make sure to [b][url=discord.hatrabbit.se]join our discord[/url][/b]for updates on the competition and to engage with other contestants.

notes.title: Update 1.6.5: The Spider Bot from Apex Construct added as new power-up & more!
notes.notes:
Hi community, we’re excited to let you know that we have just added a [b]new power-up[/b] to the game: The [b]spider enemy from VR action/adventure Apex Construct[/b], made by fellow Swedish gaming studio Fast Travel Games. Spawn it to have it aid you in your battles!

In addition to the new power-up, this update also includes a few requested improvements to the game:
[list]
[*] Added left hand support!
[*] Crash fixes on the Hush-Hush Homestead map.
[*] Brightened night-themed maps to reduce visibility issues.
[*] Bomber droid is now able to use teleporters.
[*] Turret now fires more accurately.
[*] Improved prevention of 6-dof players walking through walls.
[*] Improved hit detection on Banana Beamer
[*] Xp slider in post match result is now more accurate.
[/list]
As always, let us know if you have any questions or feedback.See you in the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33972224/b7fbab1b73aafe4cfe31577b258357b7f6a977ce.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Slightly amazing list of improvements!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33972224/8fe3b2c30d0c8420b6c30a47319793b7b23f1cf5.gif[/img]
[b]Hello community! [/b]

[i]Since the launch on Steam the game has been updated several times but we haven't posted about it on here. With the new 1.6.0 update out we'd like to share all past improvements including the new ones. Remember you can always reach out to us developers directly through our discord [url=(discord.hatrabbit.se)](discord.hatrabbit.se)[/url][/i]

[b]1.5.5[/b]
- Change region feature
- Collision bug fixes

[b]1.5.6[/b]
- Separate bot match button
- Added comfort settings to how-to-play popup
- Performance fixes
- Fixed small lightmap error on island level
- Companion app for Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=se.hatrabbit.gp.sh&hl=en)

[b]1.5.7[/b]
- Weapon balancing for all weapons
- Penalty for suicide
- Added language change support
- Bot does not keep powerup after death
- Beamer is not usable on match end
- Fixed jittering issues when losing headset tracking
- Rocket Chicken improvements
- Banana Beamer is more reliable
- Fix for players spawning on top of each other
- Tweaks on AI difficulty
- Performance fixes
- Improved projectile collisions
- A win always results in at least one ELO point
- Companion app for IOS (https://testflight.apple.com/join/kYgZwRd0)

[b]1.5.8[/b]
- Fix for sometimes infinite ammo on powerups
- Fix for burst gun shooting extremely fast on VR Companion App
- Fix for opponents becoming unhittable when joining an ongoing bot match 

[b]1.5.9[/b]
- 1 new character, 3 skins!
- 3 new maps!
- 4 new weapons skins
- New menu music
- Soft currency earned from matches
- All characters and weapons buyable through soft currency (no level restriction)
- Soft currency rewards after each level up
- See all your player stats
- See other players stats and medals
- Medals now visible in matchmaking VS screen
- See what devices/platforms people are playing on
- See top 7 ranking even if ranked below top 7 (not just number one)
- Level not capped at 20 anymore
- Bot difficulty tweaks

[b]1.6.0[/b]
- anti cheat (disconnecting means lost elo)
- full gamepad support
- new character (Baking Bad + variation)
- 2 new levels (island, snow)
